script_text: Aries, this week Mars in Gemini squares your natal Sun, igniting a storm you cannot ignore. Early week, Mercury in Leo trines your ruling Mars, sharpening career communication and Fire element clarity. Monday through Wednesday, the Sun opposing your 7th House partners creates relationship tension demanding honest conversation. Mid-week turning point: Venus enters your 5th House on Wednesday, unlocking romantic and creative energy that was blocked. Late week shifts into professional power as Jupiter transits your 10th House, amplifying career visibility Thursday through Sunday. The weekend favors reflection over bold action. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, supercharging love life and creative projects. Tuesday is your worst day because the Sun opposes your 7th House, creating partnership friction that truly escalates if you react impulsively. Channel Mars's Gemini square into focused career strategy, not domestic drama. Follow for daily updates.
